newsitem.title: THAILAND: Siam Comm Bank cuts MLR, deposit rates.
newsitem.headline: Siam Comm Bank cuts MLR, deposit rates.

text.p: The Siam Commercial Bank Plc on Tuesday followed other major Thai banks in cutting its Minimum Lending Rate (MLR) and deposit rates following a signal given by the Bank of Thailand.
A Siam Commercial Bank statement said it reduced its MLR 25 basis points to 12.75 percent and slashed its fixed deposit rates by the same margin, effective May 28.

The bank followed Thai Farmers Bank Plc, Bangkok Bank Plc and other banks in cutting prime lending rates since Monday after recent calls from the business sector that lower funding cost would help revive the sluggish Thai economy.
The Bank of Thailand on Monday relaxed guidelines for commercial banks to calculate retail lending rates, a move it said would lead to lower domestic lending rates.
